title: PINNeAPPle in Unity: twin export, a Unity scene into OpenUSD, and a live bridge
description: Three pipelines between PINNeAPPle and Unity: an engineering twin exported as a Unity project folder (fields coloured per vertex over time, sensors, legend), a Unity-authored scene read back and given checked physics that leaves as an OpenUSD layer with time samples and UsdPhysics, and an HTTP bridge the Unity runtime calls for a field while it plays, with the checks and the decision travelling with it. The three fields are also recorded as short MP4s (make_movies.py, matplotlib + ffmpeg) in media/, the same values and colour range the runtime shows.
